purpose: Audio-worker production handoff. Authored queue only; not an app resource manifest or API payload.

delivery.loudness_guidance: Aim near -22 LUFS integrated for clips >=3 seconds; short chirps judged against the bank, not forced to integrated LUFS.
delivery.loops: No baked fades; audition repeated boundaries and supply exact loop points.

cues.direction: Two soft ascending creature notes ending in a smiling breath.
